segments.narration: A man lived in a Paris airport for eighteen years. Mehran Karimi Nasseri settled into the departure lounge of Terminal 1 on the twenty-sixth of August, 1988.
His papers were gone, reportedly stolen along with his briefcase. Britain sent him back, and France could not confirm who he was.
Here is the part nobody expects. By 1999 the paperwork problem had been solved. France and Belgium both offered him residency.
He would not sign. The forms called him Iranian rather than British, and left off the name he went by, Sir Alfred Mehran.
He stayed until illness forced him out in 2006. He died in the same airport in November 2022, long after Hollywood had bought his story.
